conventions.matrix_row_major_usd: USD row-vector convention: p_world = p_local * M; rows 0-2 = local axes in world, row 3 = translation
conventions.camera_frames: USD camera looks along -Z with +Y up; quat_w_ros = OpenCV/ROS (+Z forward, -Y up)
conventions.poses_read: after env.reset() and after the course's 10 warm-up steps (initial_action), unless labelled

dr_setting.applied: all ranges degenerate at centre: exposure -1 EV, mat yaw 0, wrist focal 13.5 mm, camera offsets 0, rack offsets 0, rack_placement_prob 0, vial offsets 0 (nominal phase)

notes.value: N=f/D where D is effective aperture, f is focal length and N is f-number (2 for this cam)... but this uses aperture as sensor size, not hole light passes through after lens

images_nominal.note: rendered after the 10 warm-up steps, i.e. the first frame the policy sees

seeds.convention: v0: random/np/torch(+cuda) seeded with k immediately before env.reset(); vial pose_range = Eval ranges, every other DR at centre
